bestBeaches.metaTitle: Best Beaches in Kalkan — Travel Journal
bestBeaches.metaDescription: Our editors' favourite beaches near Kalkan: Kaputaş, Patara, and hidden coves — with tips for villa guests.
bestBeaches.title: The best beaches near Kalkan
bestBeaches.intro: Kalkan is a hill town that looks down on the sea; the beaches are a short drive away, each with its own mood. Here is where we send guests first.
bestBeaches.heroImageAlt: View of Kaputaş beach from the coastal road

sections.heading: Kaputaş
sections.body: The classic postcard: a narrow gorge opening onto turquoise water, reached by a long staircase from the D400. Arrive before 10 a.m. in July and August, bring shoes for the steps, and plan an early lunch back in Kalkan — parking fills quickly.

sections.heading: Patara
sections.body: Eleven kilometres of sand backed by dunes and ancient ruins. Gentle shallows make it ideal for families; stay for sunset. Combine with a morning visit to the archaeological site, then return to your villa pool in the late afternoon.

sections.heading: İnönü & local coves
sections.body: Smaller stone-shingle bays east of Kalkan reward those with a hire car. Pack reef shoes, water, and shade — facilities are minimal by design. Ask our concierge for the week's calmest cove if you are travelling with children.

sections.heading: Planning from your villa
sections.body: Beach days work best with a packed breakfast and a late checkout mindset. We can arrange umbrellas, cool boxes, and a skipper for days when you prefer to arrive by boat instead of road.

travelSafety.metaTitle: Safe Travel Guide — Kalkan & Lycian Coast
travelSafety.metaDescription: Practical safety tips for villa holidays in Turkey: healthcare, driving, sun, and local etiquette.
travelSafety.title: A safe travel guide for the Lycian coast
travelSafety.intro: The region is welcoming and well set up for visitors; a little preparation makes villa holidays effortless.
travelSafety.heroImageAlt: Sunlit harbour on the Turkish Mediterranean

sections.heading: Healthcare
sections.body: Kalkan has pharmacies and a clinic; hospitals are in Kaş and Fethiye. Bring prescription medicines in original packaging and EU GHIC or travel insurance details. Our concierge records your villa address for emergency services.

sections.heading: Roads and transfers
sections.body: Coastal roads are scenic but winding. If you hire a car, choose automatic transmission if you are unused to gradients. For evening meals in town, many guests prefer a taxi rather than parking on the harbour road.

sections.heading: Sun and sea
sections.body: UV is strong from May to October. Reef shoes help on pebble beaches; flags on busier beaches indicate lifeguard coverage. Drinking water at villas is typically from bottles or filtered supplies — we confirm in your pre-arrival notes.

sections.heading: Local customs
sections.body: Dress is relaxed in resorts but modest in villages and mosques. Ramadan dates vary; restaurants remain open in tourist areas. A polite greeting in Turkish — merhaba — is always appreciated.

about.metaDescription: Learn how Villa Collection curates luxury villas on the Turkish Mediterranean coast.
about.title: About Villa Collection
about.intro: We are an independent villa agency specialising in curated Mediterranean retreats. Every home in our collection is visited, priced transparently, and held to the same editorial standard you see on these pages.

sections.heading: Curated, not crowded
sections.body: We list a focused portfolio of villas rather than an endless catalogue. Each property is chosen for setting, service, and consistency — the qualities that turn a good holiday into a memorable one.

sections.heading: Transparent pricing
sections.body: Rates on our site reflect what you can expect to pay: nightly accommodation, listed offers, and fees shown before you enquire. Our team confirms availability and final terms by email — no surprises at check-in.

sections.heading: Local expertise
sections.body: Our concierge team lives and works on the coast. They coordinate arrivals, housekeeping, and special requests in English, German, or Russian, so you can plan with confidence from abroad.

privacy.metaDescription: How Villa Collection collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you browse or book.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using our services, you agree to the practices described here.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you browse our site we may collect technical data such as your IP address, browser type, and pages viewed. When you submit an enquiry or booking request, we collect the contact details and stay information you provide, including name, email, phone number, travel dates, and party size.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use your information to respond to enquiries, process booking requests, send service-related emails (including one-time access codes), improve our website, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Sharing with partners
sections.body: To fulfil a stay we may share necessary details — such as guest names and dates — with the villa owner, local manager, or payment processor. These parties are required to handle data only for the purpose of providing the service.

sections.heading: Cookies and preferences
sections.body: We use cookies to remember your language and currency preferences and to keep you signed in to secure booking pages. You can control cookies through your browser settings; some features may not work if cookies are disabled.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or to object to certain processing. Contact us at the address on our contact page to exercise these rights.

terms.metaDescription: Booking terms for villa enquiries and reservations through Villa Collection.
terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply when you enquire about or book a villa through Villa Collection. Villa-specific cancellation rules are confirmed in writing for each booking.

sections.heading: Enquiries and reservations
sections.body: Submitting an enquiry does not guarantee availability. A stay is confirmed only when we send written confirmation and, where applicable, receive any required deposit or payment. Displayed prices are estimates until confirmed by our team.

sections.heading: Guest responsibilities
sections.body: You agree to provide accurate contact and travel information, respect the villa's guest policy and house rules, and treat the property with care. You are liable for damage caused by you or members of your party beyond normal wear and tear.

sections.heading: Payments and charges
sections.body: Unless otherwise stated, prices are quoted in euros. Additional fees such as cleaning or security deposits will be disclosed before confirmation. Payment schedules and methods are set out in your booking confirmation.

sections.heading: Cancellation
sections.body: Cancellation terms vary by villa and season. The applicable policy is shown on the villa page and restated in your confirmation email. If you cancel outside the permitted window, charges may apply as stated in that policy.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Villa Collection acts as agent between you and the property owner. We are not liable for events outside our reasonable control, including weather, utilities, or third-party services. Our liability is limited to the extent permitted by applicable law.
